SELECT
  COALESCE(c.customer_city, g.geolocation_city) AS customer_city,
  COALESCE(c.customer_state, g.geolocation_state) AS customer_state,
  COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c
  ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN geolocation g
  ON c.customer_zip_code_prefix = g.geolocation_zip_code_prefix
WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= (
  SELECT MAX(order_purchase_timestamp) - INTERVAL '3 years' FROM orders
)
GROUP BY COALESCE(c.customer_city, g.geolocation_city), COALESCE(c.customer_state, g.geolocation_state)
ORDER BY order_count DESC;
